title: Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
This exhibit describes the academic calendar of International Burch University (IBU) for the 2026/2027 study year. The calendar was adopted in June 2026 and is valid only for this study year, so for other years a new calendar has to be checked.

The fall semester starts with course registration, which runs from 28 September to 2 October 2026. Classes for the first and second study cycles begin on 5 October 2026, while classes for the third cycle, the doctoral studies, begin in the week of 16 to 20 November 2026. Mid-term examinations for bachelor students take place from 23 to 27 November 2026, and Saturday, 28 November 2026, is also a working examination day. The Information Technology department has a different examination schedule.

There are several non-working days during the fall semester. Statehood Day of Bosnia and Herzegovina on 25 November and New Year's Day on 1 January 2027 are non-working days. For Catholic Christmas (25 December) and Orthodox Christmas (7 January), students receive recorded lectures. At the end of December and the beginning of January, part of the teaching takes place online: from 28 to 31 December 2026 and on 4, 5, 6 and 8 January 2027.

The last day of classes in the fall semester is 15 January 2027. It is followed by a study week to prepare for exams, from 18 to 22 January, and the final examinations run from 25 January to 3 February 2027. Make-up examinations for the first and second cycles take place from 8 to 17 February 2027.

The spring semester starts with a preparation week and course registration from 22 to 26 February 2027. Independence Day on 1 March is a non-working day, and from 2 to 5 March there is a winter break week, when academic staff are not available at the university. Classes for the first and second cycles begin on 8 March 2027, and for the third cycle on 22 March 2027. The scholarship exam is held on 21 March 2027. Mid-term examinations in the spring semester are from 26 to 30 April 2027.

The last day of classes in the spring semester is 18 June 2027. The study week runs from 21 to 25 June, and the final examinations from 28 June to 7 July 2027. The graduation ceremony is held on 2 July 2027. Make-up examinations are from 12 to 21 July 2027, and the second make-up period is from 30 August to 10 September 2027. In September there is also a special make-up date, 15 September 2027, on which a student may take only one exam.

The calendar also contains dates for future master and PhD students. Entrance exams and interviews for the first enrollment period take place on 13 and 14 July 2027, and for the second enrollment period on 14 and 15 September 2027. For students who want supplementary classes over the summer, the application deadline is 30 June 2027, and the supplementary classes begin on 1 July 2027.

The 2026/2027 academic year ends on 1 October 2027.
